name: Frame Mage
author: Chris Van Cleve
description: Move, scale, fade or hide any part of the UI with an in-game editor (F9), and reskin it with your own art.

settings.label: Frame Mage on
settings.tooltip: Off: every moved, faded or hidden element and all reskinned art go back to the game's own, live. On: your layout and skin come back.

settings.label: Layout
settings.tooltip: Which saved layout is in use. The next-layout key cycles them too.

settings.label: Snap to grid
settings.tooltip: Arrows move an element until one of its edges sits on the next grid line. Off: free movement in small steps.

settings.label: Grid size
settings.tooltip: Distance between grid lines, in UI units (1920x1080 screen).

settings.label: Show grid lines
settings.tooltip: Off: snapping still works, the lines just aren't drawn.

settings.label: Animate the centre lines
settings.tooltip: Pulses run from the centre of the screen to each edge along the cyan centre lines.

settings.label: Show the hotkey list
settings.tooltip: The list of editor keys on the left of the screen while the editor is open.

settings.label: Pause controls while editing
settings.tooltip: Shows the mouse pointer and stops the camera, movement and attacks while the editor is open, so a click selects instead of swinging.

settings.label: Level-up celebration
settings.tooltip: Fireworks and your new level zooming in, instead of the game's level-up circle. The game's level-up sound still plays.

settings.label: PREVIEW
settings.tooltip: Plays the level-up celebration now (close this menu to see it).

settings.label: Select (editor)
settings.tooltip: Click again on the same spot to select the panel around it.

settings.label: File to import
settings.tooltip: Name of a file in Mods/FrameMage/share/ (without .framemage.txt). Import replaces the current layout; the old one is kept as layouts/<name>.before-import.lua.

settings.label: EXPORT LAYOUT
settings.tooltip: Writes the current layout to Mods/FrameMage/share/<layout>.framemage.txt to send to someone.

settings.label: IMPORT LAYOUT
settings.tooltip: Reads Mods/FrameMage/share/<File to import>.framemage.txt into the current layout.
